data.content_ref: inline:The isolated entity 015bd4a327aa reduces to SRC_003 by claiming that all observed trajectories in natural numbers are merely discrete projections of a single, continuous 2-adic flow. This relation is refuted if it is shown that the transition from Z_2 (2-adic integers) back to N (natural numbers) introduces a singularity that allows for divergent trajectories not present in the p-adic space.
